sketch:
Observe: SVG canvas with two spherical bodies (Earth + apple, Earth +
Moon); student toggles between preset pairs. Force arrows on each body
(attractive). HUD: descriptive labels only — "Toutes les masses
s'attirent". 2S-level qualitative introduction to universal gravitation.
Experiment: drag one body closer/farther; arrows scale. Pick a preset
whose arrow matches a target strength. Evaluate: 3 concept cards
("what's bigger: Earth-pulling-you or you-pulling-Earth?"). Wrinkle:
no algebra, no G — just the universal proportionality intuition.
